Asset type: modular game character HEAD/FACE reference for Tripo image-to-3D, separate from hair.

Keep eyebrows, eyelashes and fine facial stubble; scalp is clean bald natural skin, not shaved dark hair or painted hair shadow. Do not turn him into the unrelated short-haired game preview model.
Exactly ONE head, strict straight-on FRONT view, eye-level orthographic camera, bilateral neutral relaxed pose, eyes looking straight ahead, lips closed, ears unobstructed. Whole scalp, both ears, chin and entire short straight neck fully visible with generous margins, portrait canvas approximately 1024x1536. Neck ends with a clean horizontal cut at its base; no shoulders, chest, bust pedestal, clothing or torso.
Realistic high-quality game character production concept, anatomically credible facial volumes, fine natural skin detail, diffuse neutral studio lighting, restrained shading that reveals forms, consistent warm natural skin tone. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. No hair, wig, hat, ears ornaments, equipment, jewelry, costume, scenery, text, labels, arrows, watermark, dramatic lighting, cast shadow or multi-view sheet. Single isolated bald head only.

Absolutely NO face, forehead, scalp skin, skull, head, neck, ears, mannequin, bust, shoulders, body, pedestal, clothing, jewelry, accessories or equipment. accepted_for_delivery: One subject and one view per image
Head has no scalp hair; eyebrows and short facial stubble retained
Hair isolated without head, face, skin, clothing or mannequin
Full silhouettes and actual transparent alpha backgrounds
review.inferred_design: Scalp, side-profile anatomy and hairstyle rear are reconstructed from the original frontal concept and are candidates, not additional views of an existing 3D model.
limitations: Generated views are visual references, not metrically calibrated orthographic projections.
Head/hair interface and nape/collar clearance require 3D fitting to the current modular male body.
Fine hair strands should be texture detail over coherent hair masses; image generation does not establish topology or rig compatibility.
